text: {"table": {"name": "card", "purpose": "Bank payment cards issued to clients (one card per disposition/client), with card type and issue date. Matches the classic Czech bank 'card' table (PK card_id, disp_id, type, issued)."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "card_id", "description": "Primary key of the card; unique integer identifier for each issued card.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "disp_id", "description": "Foreign key to disp (disposition), linking the card to a client's access on an account; one-to-one with disp/client, so each client holds at most one card.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "category", "name": "card_type", "description": "Card product tier: 'classic' (standard), 'junior' (youth card), or 'gold' (premium).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "date", "name": "issued", "description": "Date the card was issued (1993-11-07 to 1998-12-29).", "status": "resolved"}}}
